sql: SELECT "employees"."EMPLOYEE_ID" AS k, "employees"."COMMISSION_PCT" AS m1 FROM "employees" WHERE "employees"."COMMISSION_PCT" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank employees rows by commission rate
